يستأتون (form X)
# يَسْتَأْتُونَ (yastaʔtūna) /jas.taʔ.tuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
# يُسْتَأْتَوْنَ (yustaʔtawna) /jus.taʔ.taw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
